salesScripts.title: Cold Call Script - Small Business
salesScripts.introduction: Hi [Name], this is [Your Name] from [Company]. I'm reaching out because I help businesses like yours improve their operations and save money. Do you have 2 minutes?
salesScripts.mainScript: Many businesses in [their industry] struggle with [common pain point]. We've helped companies like [similar example] reduce their administrative work by 40% and improve their customer service. Would you be interested in a free demo to see how this could work for your business?
salesScripts.objectionHandling:
If 'I'm busy': I completely understand. Would tomorrow at [time] be better?

If 'Not interested': May I ask what would make this more relevant for you?

If 'Send me an email': Absolutely! I'll send you a quick overview. What's the best email?
salesScripts.closingLine: Great! Let me schedule a 15-minute demo for you. What day works best - [offer two options]?
salesScripts.exampleConversation:
Rep: Hi Mr. Johnson, this is Sarah from Tech Solutions. I'm calling because we help businesses streamline their operations. Do you have a moment?

Prospect: What kind of operations?

Rep: Things like billing, inventory management, and reporting. Many businesses like yours save several hours per week. Have you ever struggled with keeping track of all your customers and payments?

Prospect: Oh yes, that's a constant challenge.

Rep: I thought so. We've helped several businesses in [their area] solve that. Would you be open to a quick 15-minute demo to see how it works?

salesScripts.title: WhatsApp Message Script
salesScripts.introduction: Hi [Name]! I'm [Your Name]. [Referral Name] suggested I reach out to you.
salesScripts.mainScript:
I help businesses like yours digitize their operations - things like invoicing, inventory, and reporting. It's the same software that helped [referral] save [specific benefit].

Would you be open to a quick call this week to see if it could help your business too?
salesScripts.objectionHandling:
If 'What does it cost?': We offer flexible pricing starting from [price] per month. I can send you our pricing guide.

If 'I'm not sure': No problem! Would it help if I showed you how it works in just 10 minutes?

If 'Not right now': I completely understand. Can I check back with you in a few months?
salesScripts.closingLine: Perfect! Are you free on [Day] at [Time] for a quick call?
salesScripts.exampleConversation: Message: Hi Mr. Johnson! Sarah from Tech Solutions here. John Smith suggested I reach out to you.

salesScripts.title: Follow-up Message Script
salesScripts.introduction: Hi [Name]! Following up on our conversation about [topic discussed].
salesScripts.mainScript:
I wanted to check if you had any questions about the software demo I sent. Many businesses in [their industry] have found it helpful because [specific benefit].

If you're ready to get started, I can help you set up your account today. Or if you need more time, just let me know when you'd like to chat.
salesScripts.objectionHandling:
If 'Still thinking about it': Of course! Is there anything specific you'd like me to clarify?

If 'Need to discuss with partner': Absolutely, that makes sense. When do you think you'll have a chance to talk?

If 'Price is an issue': I hear you. Let me see what options we have - we do offer flexible plans.
salesScripts.closingLine: Let me know how I can help! I'm here if you have any questions.
salesScripts.exampleConversation: Message: Hi Mr. Johnson! Just wanted to follow up on our chat about the software.
